title: Admissions
subtitle: Join the Al-Noor Academy family and unlock your child's potential

process.title: Admission Process
process.description: Our admission process is designed to be straightforward and welcoming

inquiry.title: Submit Inquiry
inquiry.description: Fill out the online application form with student and guardian details

documents.title: Upload Documents
documents.description: Submit required documents including previous academic records

interview.title: Interview
interview.description: Parent and student interview with admissions committee

decision.title: Admission Decision
decision.description: Receive admission decision within 5-7 business days

enrollment.title: Enrollment
enrollment.description: Complete fee payment and enrollment formalities

fees.title: Fee Structure
fees.description: Transparent and competitive fee structure for quality education

tuition.title: Tuition Fee
tuition.description: Monthly tuition fee varies by grade level

other.title: Other Fees
other.description: Lab fees, library fees, and activity charges

age.question: What is the minimum age for admission?
age.answer: Children must be at least 5 years old by September 1st of the academic year for Grade 1 admission.

deadline.question: What is the application deadline?
deadline.answer: Applications are accepted year-round, but priority admission for the new academic year closes by May 31st.

transfer.question: Do you accept mid-year transfers?
transfer.answer: Yes, we accept mid-year transfers subject to seat availability and meeting academic requirements.

scholarship.question: Are scholarships available?
scholarship.answer: Yes, merit-based and need-based scholarships are available for qualifying students.

uniform.question: Is uniform required?
uniform.answer: Yes, all students must wear the official school uniform available at the school store.

transport.question: Is transportation provided?
transport.answer: Yes, school transport is available for most areas of Karachi for an additional fee.
